notation: One workgroup of one wave per rank, ranks over one memory with the scope model on; every workgroup is on L2 0 of its rank. buf is 64 bytes, cached unless buffer says {ipc: true} (shared, uncached). Each lane's address is buf[0]. Ops: store / store_agent (store 7 at wave / agent scope), load / load_agent / load_nt (load at wave scope / agent scope / with the non-temporal policy only), atomic / atomic_system (an add at agent / system scope), invalidate (drop the L2's kept lines), writeback (write back the L2's held bytes), wait (the load and store counters' waits, 0), busy (a 1000-round scalar loop). skew: the turns each rank waits before its first dispatch. error: the error class (ScopeModel, IpcPolicy) or null; message: the expected message with canonical operation names (informative).
